content.short: Jeeves is a global business finance platform with corporate cards, expense management and cross-border payments.
content.description: Jeeves is a global business finance platform that gives startups and growing companies corporate cards, expense management, accounts payable and cross-border payments from one dashboard. Built to work across many countries and currencies, it lets businesses issue physical and virtual cards, pay vendors and bills internationally, earn cashback and manage spend in local currencies without opening separate accounts in each market. Popular with companies in the US, Latin America and other regions, Jeeves works as international banking infrastructure for global startups, keeping approvals, reconciliation and cross-border finance in one place.
content.meta: Jeeves offers global corporate cards, expense management and cross-border payments. Discover Jeeves and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
